statutoryComponents.name: Basic Salary
statutoryComponents.description: Core taxable wage component. Base for PF, Gratuity, and Leave Encashment calculations under Indian labour laws.

statutoryComponents.name: House Rent Allowance
statutoryComponents.description: Rental accommodation allowance eligible for tax exemption under Section 10(13A) of Income Tax Act under Old Tax Regime.

statutoryComponents.name: Special Allowance
statutoryComponents.description: Flexible balancing allowance component absorbing remainder CTC. Fully taxable under both tax regimes.

statutoryComponents.name: Conveyance Allowance
statutoryComponents.description: Commute allowance. Merged under standard deduction since Budget 2018 for individual taxpayers.

statutoryComponents.name: Leave Travel Allowance
statutoryComponents.description: Domestic travel assistance eligible for tax exemption twice in a 4-year block under Old Tax Regime.

statutoryComponents.name: Statutory Annual Bonus
statutoryComponents.description: Mandatory annual bonus between 8.33% and 20% for eligible establishments under Payment of Bonus Act / Code on Wages.

statutoryComponents.name: Overtime Wages
statutoryComponents.description: Premium wages paid at double ordinary rate (2.0x) for hours worked beyond 9 hrs/day or 48 hrs/week.

statutoryComponents.name: Employee Provident Fund (EPF)
statutoryComponents.description: Mandatory employee retirement saving deduction (12% of Basic + DA up to ₹15,000 wage ceiling or actual).
statutoryActs: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952

statutoryComponents.name: Employee State Insurance (ESI)
statutoryComponents.description: Healthcare coverage contribution (0.75% of Gross) for employees with monthly gross wages up to ₹21,000.

statutoryComponents.name: Professional Tax (PT)
statutoryComponents.description: State-level municipal tax on profession/employment (max ₹2,500/year under Article 276 of Indian Constitution).
statutoryActs: State Professional Tax Acts (KA, MH, TS, TN, WB, etc.)

statutoryComponents.name: Income Tax TDS (Sec 192)
statutoryComponents.description: Withholding tax deducted at source under Sec 192 based on employee declared regime and investment proofs.

statutoryComponents.name: Employer Provident Fund (PF / EPS / EDLI)
statutoryComponents.description: 12% Employer PF split into 8.33% EPS (pension up to ₹1,250), 3.67% EPF, 0.50% EDLI, and 0.50% Admin charges.

statutoryComponents.name: Employer State Insurance (ESI)
statutoryComponents.description: 3.25% Employer health coverage contribution for gross wages <= ₹21,000/month.

statutoryComponents.name: Gratuity Provision (Actuarial)
statutoryComponents.description: Statutory gratuity accrual (15 days basic per year of service = 15/26/12 ≈ 4.81% of Basic) payable upon 5+ years tenure.
